title.zh: 将Quirino公路南甘马粦段更名为Rolando R. Andaya公路并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An act renaming the Camarines Sur Portion of the Quirino Highway as Rolando R. Andaya Highway
title.orig: An act renaming the Camarines Sur Portion of the Quirino Highway as Rolando R. Andaya Highway
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Quốc lộ Camarines Sur Portion of the Quirino thành Quốc lộ Rolando R. Andaya
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อทางหลวง Camarines Sur Portion of the Quirino เป็น ทางหลวง Rolando R. Andaya
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Jalan Raya Camarines Sur Portion of the Quirino menjadi Jalan Raya Rolando R. Andaya
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Lebuh Raya Camarines Sur Portion of the Quirino kepada Lebuh Raya Rolando R. Andaya

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2004/ra_9234_2004.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The existing Quirino Highway starting from the Camarines Sur-Quezon boundary up to the Municipality of Sipocot, Province of Camarines Sur is hereby renamed Rolando R. Andaya Highway.
The Department of Public Works and Highways is hereby directed to implement the provisions of this Act.
All laws, decrees, orders and issuances or any part thereof inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
